headline: Northeastern State take a first point off Southern Nazarene
dek: Northeastern State had lost both of their conference matches by a single goal before Southern Nazarene visited on Wednesday and went home with a draw. Southern Nazarene still lead the table, a point ahead of Fort Hays State, who have played once fewer and won both times.
displaced_by: Southern Nazarene held to a draw at Northeastern State on 2026-09-23: Northeastern State's first conference point, and the top of the table is no longer level
